run_bench_ivfpq_cuvs: run the IVF-PQ GPU benchmark script to compare classical GPU vs cuVS performance on SIFT1M
run_bench_train_milliseconds: run the GPU index training benchmark with or without cuVS enabled on training vectors
run_bench_add_milliseconds: run the GPU index add benchmark to measure vector insertion time with cuVS toggled
run_bench_search_milliseconds: run the GPU index search benchmark to measure nearest neighbor query time with cuVS toggled
run_eval_recall: run the recall evaluation function to compute recall and queries per second from search results
